 If you love the movie "Home Alone," McDonald's has a meal for you.
 Mike Snider USA TODAY Updated Nov. 17, 2026, 8:06 a.m. ET Hear this story McDonald's has a special holiday meal to spice up your annual viewing of " Home Alone ."
 The "Home Alone Meal," coming to the menu at participating restaurants nationwide on Dec. 1, will be available for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Entrée choices include Sausage Egg and Cheese McGriddles or a Big Mac, along with other limited-edition menu options and one of four pairs of McDonald’s x "Home Alone" collectible socks.
 The socks sport characters, scenes, and quotes from the film. And as Kevin McCallister (Macaulay Culkin) chows down in the 1990 holiday classic, you can boost your "Home Alone Meal" with these special menu items:
 Little Nero's Pizza McShaker Fries (available after breakfast hours). Drop your fries into this McShaker bag of tomato, garlic, cheese, and Italian herbs, and shake for a savory snack.
 Lovely Cheese Pizza Dipping Sauce (available after breakfast hours). Add this tomato sauce made with aged Parmesan cheese, garden herbs, and garlic as a side with Chicken McNuggets, McCrispy Strips, or order it à la carte with your entrée of choice.
 Everything Sundae McFlurry (sold separately). This limited-time McFlurry, available à la carte, is made with vanilla soft serve, hot fudge swirls, Oreo cookie pieces, and M&M’s.
 "Bringing together two icons people already love, McDonald's and 'Home Alone,' we're giving fans across the globe a holiday moment to share and celebrate, through nostalgic flavors, collectible keepsakes and the kind of playful experience only McDonald's can deliver," said Morgan Flatley, McDonald's interim U.S. chief creative officer, global chief marketing officer and head of new business ventures, in a statement.
 Pricing for the Home Alone Meal is set by franchisees and may vary by restaurant.
 'Tis the season: Starbucks, McDonald's, Dunkin', more offer new holiday menu items Culkin: 'Home Alone' inspired McDonald's meal is 'playful'
 Culkin reprises his role as Kevin in a new McDonald’s campaign, in which he's having fun alone in a McDonald's restaurant.
 "What I love about this collaboration is that the 'Home Alone Meal' captures something bigger than just one character: it's about the playful spirit that resonates with people across generations," Culkin said in a statement. "Bringing this to life with McDonald's and getting to reexperience these moments with my own kids, reminds me why fans keep coming back to Kevin's story. That's the magic we're celebrating here."

 As part of the "Home Alone Meal" promotion, you can get $5 off a $20 McDelivery order in the McDonald's mobile app .
 Want to stream "Home Alone"? You can use MyMcDonald’s Rewards points to redeem a 14-day free trial of the Disney+ and Hulu bundle, which includes the entire "Home Alone" movie collection.
 Round up your order as a donation to the Ronald McDonald's House .
 Participate in the McDonald's Home Alone Challenge Fan Event in Los Angeles Dec. 4-5 from 5-10 p.m. PT. The interactive event will let you try a series of challenges inspired by the film. Register for free online .
